INT-01.speaker: Mara
INT-01.caption: There you are. I'm Mara, Head of Engineering. Short version of my job: when two smart people disagree, I get the headache.

INT-02.speaker: Mara
INT-02.caption: I brought you in because I need someone who looks at the evidence, not at whoever is loudest in the room.

INT-03.speaker: Dev
INT-03.caption: Dev! Robotics Lead. I build the part where people say, wait, it did that on its own?

INT-04.speaker: Dev
INT-04.caption: TERN-1 sorts a full tray in under a minute. Slow it down and you're showing Northgate a very expensive shelf.

INT-05.speaker: Ines
INT-05.caption: Ines. Software and Safety. I make sure the robot stops when it's supposed to stop.

INT-06.speaker: Ines
INT-06.caption: I'd also like everyone to keep all ten fingers through the demo. Call me old fashioned.

INT-09.speaker: Mara
INT-09.caption: And that is the meeting I have every single day.

BRF-01.speaker: Mara
BRF-01.caption: Here's the situation. We're Halyard Robotics, building a warehouse robot called TERN-1.

BRF-02.speaker: Mara
BRF-02.caption: Our customer, Northgate, watches a live demo in twelve weeks. They want two things that don't naturally get along: a robot that works on its own, and a paper trail proving a human can override it.

BRF-03.speaker: Mara
BRF-03.caption: Dev says speed and autonomy win the contract. Ines says safeguards win it. They're both partly right, and they've stopped listening to each other.

BRF-04.speaker: Mara
BRF-04.caption: Your job, in six moves: check the evidence, settle three arguments, show the team the data, choose the robot's settings, run the demo, then see what happened.

BRF-05.speaker: Mara
BRF-05.caption: Watch the gauges at the top. Resentment, runway, readiness, team alignment, and your credibility. Every choice moves them.

BRF-06.speaker: Mara
BRF-06.caption: You can't check everything. You get three investigations, five persuasion points, and three chances to step in during the demo. Spend them like they matter.

BRF-07.speaker: Mara
BRF-07.caption: Nobody is grading you on being right. They're watching what you do with the evidence. Ready?

GUIDE-FLOOR.speaker: Mara
GUIDE-FLOOR.caption: Five things in this room could change how we argue. You can look closely at three.

GUIDE-TABLE.speaker: Mara
GUIDE-TABLE.caption: Three arguments are on this table. For each one, drop a token on who you back.

GUIDE-CONSEQUENCE1.speaker: Ines
GUIDE-CONSEQUENCE1.caption: That's how the team took it. This mood follows us into the next chapter.

GUIDE-DATA.speaker: Dev
GUIDE-DATA.caption: Four sets of numbers. Pick what we show, and in what order.

GUIDE-FORGE.speaker: Mara
GUIDE-FORGE.caption: Now the real choices. Speed, recovery, learning. And remember, a question mark means nobody measured it.

GUIDE-RUN.speaker: Mara
GUIDE-RUN.caption: Five events. The action pauses before each choice, so no countdown panic.

GUIDE-ENDING.speaker: Mara
GUIDE-ENDING.caption: The demo is over. Now let us look at what your decisions made possible.

GUIDE-DEBRIEF.speaker: Mara
GUIDE-DEBRIEF.caption: You can rewind a decision without erasing the run you just made.

DISC-E1.speaker: Dev
DISC-E1.caption: Okay. That is not in the highlight video.

DISC-E2.speaker: Ines
DISC-E2.caption: Three separate incidents. The repeated part is what matters.

DISC-E3.speaker: Mara
DISC-E3.caption: Good. Now we have two assumptions to test, instead of two people to blame.

DISC-E4.speaker: Ines
DISC-E4.caption: We tested this. We just never put the results in the same room.

DISC-E5.speaker: Mara
DISC-E5.caption: Read it twice. They're not picking a side. They want both.

MISMATCH-DEV-1.speaker: Dev
MISMATCH-DEV-1.caption: I want to like this, I really do. But it's answering a question nobody asked.

MISMATCH-DEV-2.speaker: Dev
MISMATCH-DEV-2.caption: That's like bringing a parachute to a bake sale.

MISMATCH-DEV-4.speaker: Dev
MISMATCH-DEV-4.caption: Is that a clue or a fun fact? I can't use a fun fact.

MISMATCH-INES-1.speaker: Ines
MISMATCH-INES-1.caption: That's real data. It just isn't evidence for this decision.

MISMATCH-INES-2.speaker: Ines
MISMATCH-INES-2.caption: Accurate, relevant to something, and not to this.

MISMATCH-INES-3.speaker: Ines
MISMATCH-INES-3.caption: Please connect it to the claim. I'll wait.

MISMATCH-INES-4.speaker: Ines
MISMATCH-INES-4.caption: I agree with every word of it, and it still doesn't help.

MISMATCH-INES-5.speaker: Ines
MISMATCH-INES-5.caption: You've brought a map of the wrong city.

MISMATCH-INES-6.speaker: Ines
MISMATCH-INES-6.caption: That supports a different argument. Save it.

MISMATCH-INES-7.speaker: Ines
MISMATCH-INES-7.caption: If I accept this, I have to accept anything. Try another.

MATCH-DEV-1.speaker: Dev
MATCH-DEV-1.caption: Okay, that one lands. I hate that it lands.

MATCH-INES-2.speaker: Ines
MATCH-INES-2.caption: That's the first thing today I can build on.

MATCH-MARA-1.speaker: Mara
MATCH-MARA-1.caption: Careful. Persuading someone is not the same as being right. Make sure you have both.

EVENT-1.speaker: Mara
EVENT-1.caption: Warm-up batch. Nothing scary yet. Watch how smooth it is.

EVENT-2.speaker: Ines
EVENT-2.caption: This is the moment I was worried about.

EVENT-3.speaker: Mara
EVENT-3.caption: A jam. Your recovery setting decides what happens next.

EVENT-4.speaker: Dev
EVENT-4.caption: New object. Let's see if it asks.

EVENT-5.speaker: Mara
EVENT-5.caption: This is the one Northgate sees. Fingers crossed.

LETTER-01.speaker: Northgate
LETTER-01.caption: We want a demonstration of autonomous operation. Our safety auditor requires documented override compliance.

CO-01.speaker: Mara
CO-01.caption: Robotics won't ship without full autonomy, and Software won't sign off without hard overrides. We have twelve weeks of runway and neither team will move.

CO-02.speaker: Dev
CO-02.caption: TERN-1 does 94% of picks on its own. Don't cap it. — D.

CO-03.speaker: Ines
CO-03.caption: Three near-misses in six weeks. This is not a feature request. — I.

CO-05.speaker: Mara
CO-05.caption: We want to see it run itself. Our auditor needs to see it stop.

CO-04.speaker: CONTROL
CO-04.caption: Twelve weeks. Two teams. One prototype. Walk the floor, then decide who moves.

CO-06.speaker: CONTROL
CO-06.caption: Inspect three things. You can't open everything.

FW-01a.speaker: Dev
FW-01a.caption: Ninety-four percent, hands off. Nobody has ever done that.

FW-01b.speaker: Ines
FW-01b.caption: That's the one I flagged. Point four meters.

FW-02a.speaker: Ines
FW-02a.caption: Three in six weeks. The e-stop wasn't even wired to the interlock.

FW-03a.speaker: Dev
FW-03a.caption: Capping speed kills the demo. Obviously.

FW-03b.speaker: Ines
FW-03b.caption: Confirmation prompts cost nothing. Always have.

FW-03c.speaker: CONTROL
FW-03c.caption: Two assumptions. Nobody has tested either.

FW-04.speaker: Mara
FW-04.caption: BENCH-0914. Nobody's opened it. I was waiting for a reason.

FW-05a.speaker: CONTROL
FW-05a.caption: Both lines are in the same letter.

FW-05b.speaker: Mara
FW-05b.caption: Autonomy and overrides. They want both.

FW-06.speaker: CONTROL
FW-06.caption: Three looks. That's what the morning allows.

FW-07.speaker: CONTROL
FW-07.caption: You still have looks left. Go to the table anyway?

FW-08.speaker: Dev
FW-08.caption: You only looked at Ines's side.

FW-09.speaker: Ines
FW-09.caption: You only looked at Dev's side.

T-INTRO.speaker: CONTROL
T-INTRO.caption: Three conflicts. Five alignment points. Move the tokens.

T-R-DEV.speaker: Dev
T-R-DEV.caption: Good. The setting stays in. That's the demo.

T-R-INES.speaker: Ines
T-R-INES.caption: Noted. If it hits someone, this decision is on record.

T-S-INES.speaker: Ines
T-S-INES.caption: Thank you. The setting gets the guard rails.

T-S-DEV.speaker: Dev
T-S-DEV.caption: So the demo gets a leash. Great.

T-B-DEV.speaker: Dev
T-B-DEV.caption: Fine. Show me the version that doesn't gut it.

T-B-INES.speaker: Ines
T-B-INES.caption: Fine. Show me the version that stays safe.

T-D-DEV.speaker: Dev
T-D-DEV.caption: We're not deciding? The clock is.

T-EV-CON.speaker: Mara
T-EV-CON.caption: That says the opposite of your call.

T-EV-NEU.speaker: Mara
T-EV-NEU.caption: That doesn't speak to this one.

T-AP.speaker: CONTROL
T-AP.caption: A bridge costs two points and a week.

C1-ALIGNED.speaker: Mara
C1-ALIGNED.caption: Two lanes with real agreements. It cost weeks. It's a start.

C1-ROBOTICS.speaker: Mara
C1-ROBOTICS.caption: Dev's flying. Ines isn't speaking. That won't last.

C1-SOFTWARE.speaker: Mara
C1-SOFTWARE.caption: Ines can sleep. Dev is packing a box.

C1-STALLED.speaker: Mara
C1-STALLED.caption: We decided not to decide. Finance noticed.

C1-MIXED.speaker: Mara
C1-MIXED.caption: Half a plan. Both of them still watching you.

O2-A1.speaker: Mara
O2-A1.caption: You bought us alignment. It cost weeks. Use them.

O2-R1.speaker: Nadia
O2-R1.caption: Mind if I sit in? Northgate asked me to.

O2-R2.speaker: Ines
O2-R2.caption: She's here for the override evidence.

O2-S1.speaker: Dev
O2-S1.caption: I've got another offer. Show me you're not building a leash.

O2-T1.speaker: Mara
O2-T1.caption: We're out of time to be polite.

O2-M1.speaker: Mara
O2-M1.caption: Half a plan, two tired leads. Pick what they see.

O2-CTRL.speaker: CONTROL
O2-CTRL.caption: Four sealed folders. Whatever you project, both teams see.

O2-14.speaker: Dev
O2-14.caption: Fine. I'm here. Don't make me regret it.

S-D1-DEV.speaker: Dev
S-D1-DEV.caption: Six percent? I told everyone thirty.

S-D1-INES.speaker: Ines
S-D1-INES.caption: I told you the cap was cheap.

S-D2-DEV.speaker: Dev
S-D2-DEV.caption: Eighty-one. I was wrong about unattended.

S-D2-INES.speaker: Ines
S-D2-INES.caption: Thirty-one percent of picks interrupted? I was wrong about prompts.

S-D2-MARA.speaker: Mara
S-D2-MARA.caption: First time they've agreed on anything.

S-D3-INES.speaker: Ines
S-D3-INES.caption: Point two two with the curtain. I'd sign that. Not at one-point-two.

S-D4-INES.speaker: Ines
S-D4-INES.caption: And auto-recovery is fine, with the interlock.

S-NAD-NO.speaker: Nadia
S-NAD-NO.caption: No override evidence in this meeting. Noted.

S-VETO-R.speaker: Dev
S-VETO-R.caption: Recovery stays auto. I'm not negotiating that.

S-VETO-S.speaker: Ines
S-VETO-S.caption: The cap stays at point five.

S-END.speaker: Mara
S-END.caption: Enough data. Build something they'll both sign.

F-INTRO.speaker: CONTROL
F-INTRO.caption: Three dials. A question mark means you never opened that folder.

F-REJ-DEV-1.speaker: Dev
F-REJ-DEV-1.caption: That speed makes the demo look timid.

F-REJ-INES-1.speaker: Ines
F-REJ-INES-1.caption: Show me the margin at that speed.

F-REJ-INES-2.speaker: Ines
F-REJ-INES-2.caption: No self-recovery without the interlock data.

F-REJ-INES-3.speaker: Ines
F-REJ-INES-3.caption: That learning setting has no tuned threshold.

F-REJ-INES-4.speaker: Ines
F-REJ-INES-4.caption: Never confirming is not an option.

F-IMP.speaker: Mara
F-IMP.caption: I'm calling it. Lean build. Move.

F-RUNWAY.speaker: CONTROL
F-RUNWAY.caption: Reserve: two weeks for the run.

C2-AGREED.speaker: Mara
C2-AGREED.caption: One build. Two signatures. Don't waste it.

C2-IMPOSED.speaker: Mara
C2-IMPOSED.caption: It's the safe build. It won't impress anyone.

RN-E1-H.speaker: CONTROL
RN-E1-H.caption: Event one. Warm-up batch. Hands off.

RN-E2-H1.speaker: CONTROL
RN-E2-H1.caption: Event two. A technician at point four meters.

RN-E2-ASK.speaker: CONTROL
RN-E2-ASK.caption: Let it run, or step in.

RN-E4-H.speaker: CONTROL
RN-E4-H.caption: Event four. An object it has never seen.

EN-01.speaker: Mara
EN-01.caption: Everyone was careful. Nothing was built.

EN-02.speaker: Theo
EN-02.caption: We'll pause the demo. Call me when there's something to see.

EN-03.speaker: CONTROL
EN-03.caption: The runway ran down four more weeks.

EN-F1.speaker: Nadia
EN-F1.caption: Override response failed at point four meters. I can't sign this.

EN-F2.speaker: Theo
EN-F2.caption: I can't take this to my partners.

EN-F3.speaker: Mara
EN-F3.caption: Then we find out what broke.

EN-G1.speaker: Nadia
EN-G1.caption: Documented overrides, demonstrated autonomy. I'll sign.

EN-G2.speaker: Theo
EN-G2.caption: I came for the demo. I'm staying for the team.

EN-W1.speaker: Theo
EN-W1.caption: It's remarkable. How many people does it take to run?

EN-B1.speaker: Theo
EN-B1.caption: It works if someone holds its hand all day.

EN-END.speaker: CONTROL
EN-END.caption: The run is over. The room remembers.
